rules.pre_profit: trailing-twelve-month GAAP net income ≤ 0 on FMP's quarterly income statements tonight, or the 13 Oct study's class (pre-profit or pre-revenue)
rules.class_a: every pre-profit name on tonight's RADAR, FAVORITES (station_lists) and LIKED (hub_favorites) lists; names on those lists outside the 13 Oct set were tested on stored trailing net income (Zeta joins; Intel and Lumentum are excluded as established names on write-downs)
rules.burn: mean of the two most recent quarters with negative free cash flow (operating cash flow less capex), from FMP's quarterly cash-flow statements
rules.runway: cash and short-term investments at the latest balance sheet ÷ quarterly burn, in quarters; the landing date counts from the balance-sheet date; sensitivity at 1.5× burn
rules.ntm: next-twelve-month consensus revenue = time-weighted blend of the two fiscal-year estimates straddling the twelve months after the latest reported quarter; growth is against trailing-twelve-month revenue
rules.dilution: diluted weighted-average shares, latest quarter against the same quarter a year earlier
rules.read: funded = not burning or ≥12 quarters; tight = 6 to 12; on the clock = under 6
rules.tam: the company's own stated figure with source and date from the web (read-only), one independent figure where easy to cite; 'no stated TAM' when nothing credible was found; nothing invented

not_measured: Company guidance beyond what the TAM search surfaced: FMP's earnings-call and press paths are not in the proxy's allowed list
